# Notice to Market 2026-27 - solar PV rebate requirements

Based on State of Victoria material licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution
4.0 International licence. Retrieved 2026-09-01; source page updated 2026-06-30.
The material is abridged and excludes images, branding, government arms and
third-party content.

## 3.2.2 Solar PV inverter recommendations

Solar PV inverters should use the power quality response mode region settings in
AS/NZS 4777.2, with Australia A as the default setting. Installations must comply
with the applicable DNSP connection agreement.

## 3.2.3 Solar PV module mandatory requirements

Solar PV modules must be listed on the Solar Victoria product list and on the Clean
Energy Council approved modules list. The retailer must ensure the system is designed
and installed so that it is eligible for small-scale technology certificates.

| Requirement | Minimum evidence |
|---|---|
| Product listing | Current Solar Victoria and CEC approved-list entries |
| STC eligibility | Valid module serial numbers and claim evidence |
| Product warranty | At least five years for eligible modules |

The table is kept intact because each evidence item qualifies the requirement in the
same row.
